verdict.rationale: Jan's privacy docs say "Zero data collection until you say so", which means telemetry is off by default and only enabled with consent; this goes further than opt-out. The repo's "Privacy First" and "full control and privacy" claims and its local-first design support that posture. missing for 10: documentation of the actual analytics toggle and what data is collected once enabled, and independent or hands-on verification that no tracking occurs by default.
